conditions: Undriven, undamped ideal linear mass-spring oscillator with positive effective oscillating mass and spring constant; nonzero oscillation amplitude within the linear range.
spoken_aliases: t equals two times pi times the square root of open parenthesis m divided by k close parenthesis
oscillation period equals two pi times the square root of the ratio of mass to spring constant

evidence: Newton's law and the linear restoring force give m x''=-kx. Nonzero oscillations solve this equation with angular frequency sqrt(k/m). A complete cycle advances phase by 2 pi, giving the stated period.
Reference checked 2026-11-27: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/15-key-equations. Proposed maintainer approval, not independent human certification.
